$comment: Every environment variable this app knows about: purpose, tier and where its value lives. NO VALUES here. Values live in the encrypted vault (secrets/<env>.sops.env) or in the admin panel. Checked by scripts/env-check.mjs; synced by scripts/secrets.mjs.

tiers.bootstrap: Needed to reach or decrypt the database, so it cannot live in it. Set on the platform (Coolify/Vercel/AWS) from the vault.
tiers.public: Not secret; baked into the browser bundle at BUILD time. Set on the platform as build-time vars.
tiers.secret: Admin > Settings > Secrets (encrypted app_secrets). Env value is only a fallback until saved there.
tiers.config: Admin > Settings (app_config). Env value is only a fallback until saved there.
tiers.local: Local scripts / first-run only. Never set in production.
tiers.framework: Set by Node/Next/the build system. Never set by hand.
tiers.deprecated: Not read by the code. Remove from every platform.

DATABASE_URL.purpose: Direct Postgres connection for admin writes and the audit log (mutate/perform_action).

source.supabase_cloud: Dashboard > Connect > connection string. Long-running Node (Coolify, AWS ECS/App Runner/EC2): Session pooler :5432 or direct. Serverless (Vercel, Lambda): Transaction pooler :6543.
source.supabase_selfhosted: postgres://postgres:<POSTGRES_PASSWORD>@<db container hostname>:5432/postgres on the shared Docker network (Coolify Supabase service env: SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES); app and DB must share the network or use the published port

source.supabase_cloud: Dashboard > Project Settings > API Keys > service_role / secret key (server only)
source.supabase_selfhosted: SERVICE_ROLE_KEY of the Supabase stack (Coolify Supabase service env: SERVICE_SUPABASESERVICE_KEY)

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.purpose: Supabase API URL used by browser and server clients.

source.supabase_cloud: Dashboard > Project Settings > API (Data API) > Project URL (https://<ref>.supabase.co)
source.supabase_selfhosted: Your Supabase API (Kong) public URL = API_EXTERNAL_URL of the Supabase stack (Coolify: the Supabase service's Kong FQDN)

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.purpose: Public anon key for the browser Supabase client (RLS-protected).

source.supabase_cloud: Dashboard > Project Settings > API Keys > anon / publishable key
source.supabase_selfhosted: ANON_KEY of the Supabase stack (Coolify Supabase service env: SERVICE_SUPABASEANON_KEY)

source.generate: openssl rand -hex 32  (exactly 64 hex chars). Generate ONCE; it must be identical on every host that reads the same database, forever (or rotate via _V2).

CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY_V2.purpose: Next key version during a rotation.

source.generate: openssl rand -hex 32, only when rotating; then set CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY_CURRENT=2 and run Admin > Settings > Encryption Keys

CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY_CURRENT.purpose: Which key version new writes use (default 1).

ACCOUNT_DELETION_ENCRYPTION_KEY.purpose: Encrypts deleted-account snapshots during the grace period.

source.generate: openssl rand -hex 32 (64 hex chars). Same on every host that reads the same database.

OTP_HASH_SECRET.purpose: HMAC key for OTP and deletion-token hashes (read synchronously, so env-only for now).

source.generate: openssl rand -hex 32. Changing it invalidates codes in flight only.

NEXT_PUBLIC_GA4_ID.purpose: Google Analytics measurement id for the browser tag.

source.vendor: Google Analytics > Admin > Data streams > (web stream) > Measurement ID (G-XXXXXXX)

NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.purpose: Canonical site URL override (defaults to siteConfig.url).

source.generate: https://www.yourdomain.com. Leave UNSET on Vercel preview deployments so previews do not claim production URLs.

WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN.issuer: self-generated, copy to Meta webhook config

WEBHOOK_SECRET.purpose: Shared secret for inbound blog/Notion webhooks.

CRON_SECRET.issuer: self-generated, copy to the scheduler's Authorization header
CRON_SECRET.purpose: Authorises scheduled-job routes; they refuse every call when unset.

source.generate: openssl rand -hex 32; the same value goes into the scheduler's Authorization: Bearer header (Coolify scheduled task / Vercel Cron)

CLOUDFLARE_CACHE_PURGE_TOKEN.purpose: Purges changed URLs from the Cloudflare edge on publish.

GEMINI_API_KEY.purpose: Cloud fallback model for the WhatsApp assistant.

LOCAL_AI_SECRET.purpose: Bearer token for the local vLLM auth shim.

GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY.purpose: GA4 + Search Console reporting and sitemap resubmit.

GITHUB_RELEASE_TOKEN.purpose: Delivers paid builds from private releases.

N8N_BLOG_PUBLISHED_WEBHOOK_URL.purpose: n8n webhook fired on blog publish (URL embeds a secret path).

N8N_COMMENT_POSTED_WEBHOOK_URL.purpose: n8n webhook fired on new comment.

R2_ACCOUNT_ID.purpose: Cloudflare R2 account for product assets.

CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID.purpose: Cloudflare zone for cache purge (not secret).

WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID.purpose: Meta phone number id used to send WhatsApp messages.

NOTION_DATABASE_ID.purpose: Notion database synced to the blog.

BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAILS.purpose: Emails granted admin on first sign-in. Remove after the first admin exists.

ADMIN_ACTOR.purpose: Actor for local scripts/tests that have no session. Never in production.

BUILD_TARGET.purpose: stable = build into .next-stable for the :3002 service.

NEXT_PUBLIC_RAZORPAY_KEY_ID.purpose: Unused: the key id comes from Payments > Gateway Config.

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ID.purpose: Legacy alias read as a fallback for NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL. Remove the code fallback once production is confirmed not to set it.

source.generate: Do not set (legacy alias of NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL).

SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE.purpose: Path to the age private key used by scripts/secrets.mjs (default ~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt).

COOLIFY_BASE_URL.purpose: Coolify URL for scripts/secrets.mjs sync coolify (operator shell only).

COOLIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN.purpose: Coolify API token for scripts/secrets.mjs sync coolify (operator shell only).

COOLIFY_APP_UUID.purpose: Coolify application uuid targeted by sync coolify.

VERCEL_TOKEN.purpose: Vercel token for scripts/secrets.mjs sync vercel (operator shell only).

VERCEL_PROJECT.purpose: Vercel project id or name targeted by sync vercel.

VERCEL_TEAM_ID.purpose: Optional Vercel team id for sync vercel.

coolify.set_with: pnpm secrets sync coolify --env prod --apply  (or Application > Environment Variables)
coolify.notes: phase=build vars must be ticked 'Build Variable'; redeploy after changes.

vercel.set_with: pnpm secrets sync vercel --env prod --apply  (or Project > Settings > Environment Variables)
vercel.notes: Scope per Production / Preview / Development; NEXT_PUBLIC_* need a redeploy; use the Supabase transaction pooler (:6543) for DATABASE_URL.

aws.set_with: Not automated yet. Store bootstrap vars in Secrets Manager (or SSM Parameter Store SecureString) and reference them from the task/service definition (ECS 'secrets', App Runner 'runtime env secrets', Amplify env + SSM).
aws.notes: phase=build vars must be present at BUILD (Amplify build env / docker build args), not only at runtime. Supabase on AWS = Supabase cloud (its ap-south-1 region runs on AWS) or self-hosted on EC2/ECS; plain RDS is not enough (auth.users / auth.uid() dependency, see docs/PORTABILITY.md).

local.notes: Use a separate dev Supabase project or local supabase start; never the production keys.
